study: targeted matched RF trajectory sensitivity on existing full-domain P4 electrode-displacement fields
initial_condition_source: V4 equal-peak h35 boundary pair; rotating survived 1000 RF periods and standing escaped at 882.757 RF periods
limits: a retained trajectory is right-censored at 1000 RF periods and is not a permanent-stability claim
finite deterministic examples do not establish a fabrication tolerance
N48 symmetry-restricted fields are not used for displaced geometries
P4 h50 fields are reused; no FEM meshes or field solutions are rebuilt
